items.title: 权威报告：中国AI云市场爆发，阿里云占比38.1%稳居第一，超二三四名总和
items.raw_excerpt: 5月19日，国际权威市场调研机构英富曼（Omdia）发布最新的《中国AI云市场份额2025》报告，2025年中国AI云市场总规模达567亿元人民币，其中，阿里云在AI IaaS和MaaS两大领域均位列第一，总份额从上半年的35.8%上涨至38.1%，整体稳居第一，超过二到四名总和。   图说：Omdia《中国AI云市场份额2025》阿里云第一   Omdia认为，云计算因为AI大模型的兴起迎来了最深刻的范式变革，因此，中国AI云市场必须要系统性重新衡量。Omdia首次将AI云定义为AI IaaS 和MaaS两大核心领域，其中，MaaS再细分为面向模型再开发的MPS（Model Production Service）以及以tokens消耗为主的MCS（Model Consumption Serivce）。Omdia报告显示，中国AI云市场2025年处于大幅增长阶段，整体市场规模约为567亿元人民币，IaaS占比约69%，MaaS约为31%。整体上看，阿里云市场份额38.1%位列第一，火山引擎、百度云、腾讯云、天翼云分列第二到五名，前五名云厂商市场占比总和超过八成。 AI IaaS仍占AI云市场的大头，Omdia将其定义为支撑AI计算的GPU、存储、网络等资源市场。Omdia报告显示，中国AI IaaS总规模达392亿元，阿里云以38.6%的份额稳居第一，占比远超余下厂商，头部效应尤为明显。Omdia指出，AI IaaS的客户主要集中在自动驾驶、智能座舱、AI for Science等领域，行业壁垒较高；当前竞争核心已从GPU数量转向计算、存储、网络等系统性工程能力，头部厂商需在高性能互联、集群调度编排及推理加速等维度，将GPU利用率维持在90%以上。据了解，阿里云的灵骏智算集群可提供万卡训推一体AI算力，得益于多级亲和性与拓扑感知调度设计，可实现卡间互联路

On May 19, the internationally authoritative market research firm Omdia released its latest report, "China AI Cloud Market Share 2025." In 2025, the total size of China's AI cloud market reached 56.7 billion RMB. Alibaba Cloud ranked first in both AI IaaS and MaaS, with its overall share rising from 35.8% in the first half of the year to 38.1%, firmly holding the top position and surpassing the combined share of the second to fourth place providers.  

Caption: Omdia "China AI Cloud Market Share 2025" – Alibaba Cloud ranks first.  

Omdia believes that cloud computing is undergoing its most profound paradigm shift due to the rise of large AI models, necessitating a systematic reassessment of China's AI cloud market. For the first time, Omdia defines AI cloud as two core areas: AI IaaS and MaaS. MaaS is further subdivided into MPS (Model Production Service), focused on model redevelopment, and MCS (Model Consumption Service), primarily based on token consumption.  

According to Omdia's report, China's AI cloud market experienced significant growth in 2025, with a total market size of approximately 56.7 billion RMB. IaaS accounted for about 69%, while MaaS made up around 31%. Overall, Alibaba Cloud led with a 38.1% market share, followed by Volcengine, Baidu Cloud, Tencent Cloud, and Tianyi Cloud in second to fifth place. The combined market share of the top five cloud providers exceeded 80%.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 19 de mayo, la agencia internacional de investigación de mercado Omdia publicó el informe «Cuota de mercado de la nube de IA en China 2025». En 2025, el mercado total de la nube de IA en China alcanzó los 56.700 millones de yuanes. Alibaba Cloud ocupó el primer lugar tanto en AI IaaS como en MaaS, con una cuota total que pasó del 35,8 % en el primer semestre al 38,1 %, manteniéndose en primer lugar y superando la suma de los puestos segundo a cuarto. Omdia considera que la computación en la nube está experimentando la transformación de paradigma más profunda debido al auge de los grandes modelos de IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: From May 14 to 16, the 2026 Global AI Terminal Expo and the 7th Shenzhen International Artificial Intelligence Exhibition were grandly held at the Shenzhen Futian Convention and Exhibition Center. With the theme "Terminal Empowers the Future, Everything Reborn," the exhibition gathered enterprises across the entire AI industry chain, exploring new industry opportunities around cutting-edge directions such as AI terminal iteration, edge computing, Xinchuang integration, and industry implementation. Jiangyuan Technology was invited to attend the exhibition, showcasing multiple self-developed AI terminal products based on the domestic AI computing power track. On-site, it officially launched the Jiangyuan D20D Intelligent Computing All-in-One, and during the concurrent award ceremony, it won two authoritative industry awards, making it one of the most notable enterprises at the exhibition. This exhibition brought together high-quality enterprises across the entire AI industry chain, showcasing the latest generation of intelligent hardware and computing power solutions, promoting collaborative industry development and technical exchange and cooperation. Leveraging its own R&D capabilities, Jiangyuan Technology brought desktop-level Xinchuang intelligent computing products to the exhibition, providing practical and efficient support solutions for localized AI deployment and industry implementation. During the new product launch segment of the exhibition, the Jiangyuan D20D Intelligent Computing All-in-One (Xinchuang Edition) was officially introduced. The entire machine is built on a fully domestic supply chain, equipped with Jiangyuan's self-developed D20 AI accelerator card, featuring core advantages such as 560T high-performance AI computing power, 256GB ultra-large video memory, low power consumption, and silent operation. excerpt_i18n.en: On May 18, Baidu released its Q1 2026 financial report, showing total quarterly revenue of 32.1 billion yuan. Baidu's core business revenue reached 26 billion yuan, up 2% year-over-year, exceeding market expectations. Among this, AI business revenue was 13.6 billion yuan, accounting for 52% of Baidu's core business revenue, and has grown for multiple consecutive quarters. "In Q1, Baidu's AI business revenue share exceeded half of its core business revenue for the first time, indicating that AI has become Baidu's core growth driver," said Robin Li, Baidu's founder. "Driven by surging enterprise demand and our differentiated full-stack AI capabilities built over the years, AI cloud revenue has shown strong growth momentum. Baidu's AI applications continue to expand their influence among enterprises and individuals, further validating the commercial potential of Baidu's AI innovations. Meanwhile, Apollo Go has maintained triple-digit growth in fully driverless ride-hailing trips and continues to advance its international expansion. We believe AI will bring greater value to Baidu in the coming quarters." Full-stack AI capabilities stand out, AI cloud grows 79% rapidly. In the quarter, Baidu AI cloud revenue was 8.8 billion yuan, up 79% year-over-year; GPU cloud revenue grew 184% year-over-year. Baidu Intelligent Cloud has been fully upgraded to a new full-stack AI cloud for large-scale agent applications, with comprehensive evolution of Agent Infra and AI Infra capabilities, further strengthening end-to-end collaboration from underlying computing power to agent applications, providing a solid foundation for agent development. In terms of computing hardware, Kunlun Core P800 completed large-scale validation and delivered multiple 10,000-card clusters.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 18 de mayo, Baidu publicó los resultados financieros del primer trimestre de 2026, que muestran unos ingresos totales trimestrales de 32 100 millones de yuanes. Los ingresos del negocio general de Baidu alcanzaron los 26 000 millones de yuanes, un aumento interanual del 2 %, superando las expectativas del mercado. De estos, los ingresos del negocio de IA fueron de 13 600 millones de yuanes, lo que representa el 52 % de los ingresos del negocio general de Baidu, y han crecido durante varios trimestres consecutivos. «En el primer trimestre, los ingresos del negocio de IA de Baidu superaron por primera vez la mitad de los ingresos del negocio general, lo que demuestra que la IA se ha convertido en el motor principal de Baidu», afirmó Robin Li, fundador de Baidu. «Impulsados por el aumento de la demanda empresarial y las capacidades diferenciadas de IA de pila completa que hemos desarrollado durante años, los ingresos de la nube de IA han mostrado un fuerte impulso de crecimiento. Las aplicaciones de IA de Baidu continúan en el ámbito empresarial».

On May 18, 2026, Shanghai — The evolution curve of AGI in the physical world is being redefined by China's top engineering teams. Today, Matrix Super Intelligence, a hardcore benchmark in the embodied intelligence field, grandly hosted the "2026 Matrix Super Intelligence Tech Day (AI DAY)" at the Zhangjiang Integrated Innovation Park in Shanghai. This is not just a technology showcase but a powerful breakthrough by domestic embodied intelligence toward global top-tier standards. Led by Zhang Haixing, former founding leader of Tesla China Design and Research Center, the "engineering dream team" deeply understands the underlying logic of transitioning from laboratories to large-scale industrialization. The team does not blindly pursue single metrics but adheres to first principles, systematically reconstructing core joints, the dexterous hand MATRIX HAND, and the generalized brain to create a truly operational, globally competitive "Chinese Optimus." On-site, the MATRIX-3 all-purpose flagship humanoid robot stunned the audience with its impressive real-world operations, declaring the perfect integration of its "digital brain" and "robust body."  

Technical Breakthrough: Deep Integration of Generalized Brain and Robust Body  
In product iteration and technological breakthroughs, any grand vision requires down-to-earth progress. From the first-generation engineering prototype verifying the feasibility of full direct-drive joints and proving China's independent robot development capabilities to the newly released MATRIX-3, the series has undergone a massive leap in size and design philosophy. The newly unveiled MATRIX-3 stands 170 cm tall and weighs 65 kg, regarded as a counterpart to humans.

Hoy, Matrix Superintelligence, un referente sólido en el campo de la inteligencia encarnada, celebró con gran éxito el "2026 Matrix Superintelligence Tech Day (AI DAY)" en el Parque de Innovación Integrada Zhangjiang de Shanghái. Este evento no solo es una exhibición tecnológica, sino también un poderoso avance de la inteligencia encarnada nacional hacia los más altos estándares globales. Liderado por Zhang Haixing, exdirector fundador del Centro de Diseño e Investigación de Tesla China, el "Equipo de Ensueño de Ingeniería" comprende a fondo la lógica subyacente de pasar del laboratorio a la industrialización a gran escala. El equipo no persigue ciegamente indicadores únicos, sino que se adhiere a los principios fundamentales, centrándose en el núcleo.
